ASSAM SCHEDULE VIII FORM NO. 127 
HIGH COURT CRIMINAL FORM (M) 166 
 
IN THE COURT OF THE CIVIL JUDGE, (SENIOR DIVISION), SEPPA, EAST KAMENG 
ARUNACHAL PRADESH 
 
Execution Petition No. 04/2025 
-in- 
NIA Case No. 03/2024 
(Smti. Mepa Rimo –vs- Shri Logo Bagang) 
Under Section – Order 21, Rule 11(2), Sec 55 and 151 of CPC, 1908 
 
Date 
Order 
Signature 
 
23.10.2025 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This is an execution petition being registered as 
Execution Petition No. 04/2025 filed by the applicant Smti. Mepa 
Rimo under order 11 (2) section 55 and 151 of the CPC, 1908 
praying for the execution of award dated 14.09.2024 for the 
arrest and detention of judgment debtor Shri Logo Bagang in 
NIA Case No. 03/2024. 
          The applicant is represented by her learned counsel Mr. 
Tango Gyadi. 
          I have heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and 
he has prayed for withdrawal of the case with liberty to file 
afresh and the same is allowed.  
          With this the Execution Petition No 04/2025 is disposed 
of on withdrawal. 
 
 
 
 
  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
(Damge Niri) 
Civil Judge 
(Sr. Dvn), 
Seppa
